source.quote: Audiophonics' own product page, read 2026-11-27, for the EVO-SABRE DAC module. « Puce DAC | 2x ESS ES9038Q2M » in « Symétrique » (dual mono). Inputs: S/PDIF coaxial and optical, Bluetooth, « USB-B (XMOS) » with « XMOS U208 », I2S on the Raspberry Pi GPIO. Rates per input: « USB : 768kHz / DOP256 »; « RPI I2S : 384kHz / DOP128 »; « SPDIF : 192kHz / DOP64 ». Outputs: RCA « 2V RMS » and XLR « 4V RMS ». Logic: « Altera Max ».

facts.chip: Two ESS ES9038Q2M, one per channel (dual mono, balanced), behind an XMOS XU208 USB receiver.

_maker_terms: See brands/audiophonics.json: the maker's terms forbid reproduction; recorded on the project owner's decision of 2026-11-27, pending written permission.
_THE_PAGE_CONTRADICTS_ITSELF_ON_SPDIF_DS: The specification table says « SPDIF : 192kHz / DOP64 »; the prose above it says the S/PDIF inputs accept « DSD 128 DOP ». The table is kept, being the lower and the more specific; the conflict is written here rather than resolved by guessing.
_one_record_for_module_and_packs: Audiophonics also sells the same module as « EVO-SABRE PACK » (with case, Raspberry Pi and supply, listed as a network player) and in a RaspDAC variant. Same converter and inputs: recorded once, the packs as editions.
